objective: Define a versioned European public procurement ontology aligned with eForms while preserving notice optionality, provenance, privacy and deterministic claim boundaries.
outcome: The first universe ontology models six notice blocks, eighteen entity types, version and lifecycle relations, eligible observed and calculated claims, proposal-only claims, prohibited claims, quality dimensions and independent kill switches.

skills.activation_reason: Map eForms concepts into bounded AXIGNAL entities, relations and claim classes.
Separate observed, calculated, proposal-only and prohibited procurement claims.
Preserve source-version, raw-notice and field-mapping boundaries.
Minimise natural-person contact and award data.
Preserve original notice language separately from localised rendering.
Validate completeness, optionality, forbidden claims and non-admission state.

external: TED Search API and Open Data documentation
User-supplied domain decomposition reviewed against official documentation

prohibited_scope: Claim that every notice contains every field
Treat missing value, deadline, award or winner as zero or negative evidence
Use contact-person data as canonical opportunity evidence
Treat search-result JSON as sufficient raw evidence for every claim
Infer supplier suitability, profitability or win probability
Activate live ingestion or public universe support

acceptance_evidence.description: Machine-readable procurement ontology with six notice blocks and explicit optionality.
Official eForms notice content and field metadata corroborate the six-block decomposition.
First-universe verifier checks ontology block IDs, authority classes, privacy restrictions and disabled runtime state.

traces: notice projection to canonical XML evidence

rollback.strategy: Pin the previous ontology version, quarantine claims produced by the superseded mapping and preserve raw notices for deterministic replay.
rollback.kill_switch: Disable the affected SDK version, notice subtype, field mapping or entire TED source independently.

goal_lock_checks.evidence: The ontology connects discovery filters to complete official notice evidence.
Every canonical class requires raw notice lineage and versioned mapping.
NUTS and place fields support Globe, organisations and awards support Graph, and notice versions support Timeline.
Query demand and saved investigations remain separate from procurement evidence.
Original languages and localised renderings are separate ontology dimensions.
Versioned procedure and award state creates durable structured knowledge beyond generic search.
Suitability, profitability, win probability and bid execution are prohibited.
Personal contact fields are restricted and linked documents require separate source admission.
The ontology defines source, subtype, SDK and field-level kill switches.
This task completes the authorised ontology dependency for the first universe.
